Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling on the roadway in League City, Texas, and was turning left when the vehicle was struck by
Driver 2, whose vehicle was proceeding through the intersection. Driver 1 reported a wrist injury at the scene. The
force and direction of the impact are consistent with the injury Driver 1 described. Driver 1 was seated in the vehicle
when the collision occurred, and both the responding officer and the witnesses at the scene confirmed this. Driver 2
gave a statement describing the collision in the same sequence Driver 1 reported. Two witnesses independently
described the events consistent with both accounts. Scene photograhps were taken and show damage concentrated
aolng the side of Driver 1's vehicle, which matches the described impact. No prior damage to the vehicle was
observed or reported. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. No citations were
issued at the scene, and both drivers were advised to exchange insurance information and seek medical evaluation
as needed.
